items.title: Amazon is investing in the Lean Focused Research Organization
items.summary: We want to tell you about an investment we're making and why we're excited about it. As AI agents increasingly make decisions that move money, approve claims, and operate critical infrastructure, the standard approach to software testing is no longer sufficient. Testing checks the cases you thought of, but there is a fundamentally different approach: mathematical proof, which shows with certainty that a system cannot
items.summaryZh: 亚马逊宣布对Lean专注研究组织（FRO）进行其历史上最大规模的长期财务资助，以推动Lean编程语言在现代软件规模下形式化数学证明的普及。Lean作为公理化数学证明工具，在训练低错误率大模型和神经符号AI（Neurosymbolic AI）方面扮演关键角色。亚马逊希望借助Lean的数学严谨性与生成式AI耦合，为做出高风险决策的AI智能体提供无可辩驳的正确性验证，确保未来智能体安全可靠。
